_about: Concept subjects for Zone 1, first pass. tools/pipeline/New-ConceptJobs.ps1 expands each subject into one job per seed using stylekit/prompt-fragments.json. 'world' lists fragment names from the 'world' section to append.

subjects.subject: Rolling green meadows under a huge bright sky, a winding dirt road leading toward the horizon, a lone traveller with a sword on their back seen small from behind.
Open wind-swept meadow with low dry-stone walls, wind-bent trees and a shallow stream, a few giant pale seed husks half sunk in the grass.
The gate of a small friendly town built in and around the giant husk, patched wooden houses, rope bridges, paper lanterns, banners, market stalls, villagers.
A cosy lantern-lit town square at dusk inside the curved wall of the giant husk, a well in the middle, a notice board, an inn with a round door, warm windows.
A small wayside shrine made from a waist-high pale cream seed husk split open like a cradle, lined with soft moss, glowing gently gold inside, on a ring of flat stones.
A vast cave where an enormous pale wooden tree root has broken through the rock ceiling, hanging root hairs, shallow pools reflecting gold light, a narrow path leading into darkness.

A towering guardian golem made of twisted pale tree roots and grey stone slabs, four metres tall, broad shoulders, long heavy arms, small head with one soft gold glowing knot for a face, moss on its shoulders, calm not evil.
A small round creature that is a knee-high spiky seed burr, chestnut brown with cream spike tips, two tiny stubby legs, two round angry eyes, no arms, cute but mischievous.
A stocky boar-like beast with a ridge of long wooden thorns along its back, mossy green-brown fur, short bark-coloured tusks, lowered head ready to charge, side-on three-quarter view.
An empty suit of old dented knight armour grown through with bark and roots, no person inside, leaves sprouting from the helmet visor, holding a chipped sword and a round wooden shield, human sized.
A young adventurer in simple starter clothes: cream linen tunic, soft green short cloak, brown leather belt with pouches, sturdy boots, fingerless gloves, friendly determined face, short hair.
A warm middle-aged village innkeeper with rolled sleeves, a patched apron, a wooden ladle on the belt, kind smile, earthy clothes in cream, tan and leaf green.
A short one-handed training sword, plain steel blade with a rounded tip, simple straight crossguard, leather-wrapped grip, round pommel, slightly chunky proportions.
A round shield made from a curved piece of pale cream seed husk, rimmed with riveted iron, a leaf emblem painted in green, leather straps at the back, front view tilted.
A simple long spear, ash wood shaft, leaf-shaped steel head, green cloth wrap below the head, standing upright.
A one-handed woodcutter's axe adapted for fighting, curved wooden haft, single bearded steel head, leather wrap, slightly chunky proportions.
A short dagger whose blade is one large polished dark wooden thorn, brass collar, cord-wrapped grip.
A simple wooden recurve bow of pale willow with green cord wrapping at the grip, strung, standing upright.
A combat training dummy: a wooden post with a straw-stuffed burlap torso and head, two short wooden arms, a dented old pot helmet, a painted red target on the chest, on a wooden cross base.
A hanging lantern made from a small hollow seed husk with cut-out leaf shapes, warm gold light inside, an iron hook and short chain on top.
A small one-room cottage built from curved pale husk panels and timber, round door, thatched roof, a crooked chimney, flower box under a round window.
A straight four-metre section of low dry-stone field wall, chunky rounded grey stones, moss and small flowers on top, modular with flat ends.
